source: derived from BLS CUSR0000SA0 via api.bls.gov v1
description: US CPI-U all items, SA, month-over-month inflation rate, percent (100*log-diff of the index). Oct-2025 index interpolated (BLS shutdown gap), so Oct/Nov-2025 m/m are split evenly.
derivation: s=truth.bls_series('CPIAUCSL'); s=s.reindex(pd.date_range(s.index.min(),s.index.max(),freq='MS')).interpolate(); mom=(100*np.log(s).diff()).dropna().round(4)  # Oct-2025 level interpolated (BLS shutdown gap)
name: bls_cpi_mom_sa_pct
